semantic.justification: TaskSGE6BG implements controlled React/Tailwind Calc presenters for native grid,input-window and sheet-tab responsibilities. They consume actual ScViewData/ScMarkData and controller display/input projections,never a second cell,selection or draft model. The grid paints a bounded viewport on a full-domain scroll canvas,with logical ARIA coordinates,source active/marked cell state,headers,inline edit focus and unchanged keyboard/pointer/IME intents. Input-window function/sum/equals and OK/cancel composition follows native mode switching. Tabs read actual sheet names and selected/active identities. Native commands,formatting,draft state and navigation stay with their controllers. Exact Writer toolbar-button styles are extracted into framework/browser/presentation/office-control-styles.ts and shared by Writer/Calc; global fonts,slate/indigo palette,Tailwind,rounded states and Lucide icons are reused. This task implements presentation contracts,not a registered production Calc module or complete editable workbench. Task77 adds normal unmerged local-reference mouse input using actual ScInputHandler selected UTF16 text,ScModule ordered dispatch,ScViewData reference start/end and ScTabView block/function-set owners. Browser formula pointing precedes Commit and preserves the edit origin;ordinary cell dragging retains the active anchor while headers move their native cursor endpoint. Shift extends;Ctrl adds/subtracts native ScMarkData/ScMultiSel selections. This is bounded source-backed foundation work,not full Calc parity. Merged cells,fill/transfer/move,protected/alternate/split views,reference dialogs,external/3D/matrix calculation,EditEngine and complete VCL painting remain unported. React binds the sole controller draft and DOM caret,uses shared Writer/VCL pointer capture and styling,and paints reference rectangles separately from ordinary native marks. Browser viewport/physical scroll mapping and repeat capture are platform adaptations;desktop scroll acceleration and complete range-finder parsing remain unported. Actual paste/composition commands use the original selected-reference collapse contract before native DOM editing. Selection notifications include their associated DOM text so stale controlled-render events cannot overwrite a newer native draft selection. Final74 browser regression exposed a real input-focus race after ODS open:controlled layout re-applied the native end caret after browser select-all,so replacement appended to existing text. Source ScTextWnd::GetFocus delegates to WeldEditView without resetting selection. The presenter now records actual browser-owned TOP focus for that layout transaction and preserves its selection;programmatic native Formula/AutoSum/reference focus still projects native caret/ranges. Already-TOP programmatic focus does not restart native input. No timer,heuristic text rewrite or second editor model is introduced. Actual DOM select-all replacement/history regression and existing native argument/reference selection tests pass.
